get_runtime_dir: get the runtime directory path by returning the first entry in sys.path
get_detectron_ops_lib: find and return the path to the Detectron ops GPU library by searching common install prefixes
get_custom_ops_lib: retrieve the path to the custom Detectron ops GPU library from the build directory
set_up_matplotlib: configure matplotlib to use the non-interactive Agg backend for headless rendering
yaml_load: load and parse a YAML string or file into a Python dictionary using yaml.load
